CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Thursday, December 21, 2023
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Special Meeting, 6:00 PM

Axzel Roman, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez, Commissioner
Ana Rodriguez, Commissioner  Luis Gonzalez, Commissioner
  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission Special Meeting was called to order on Thursday, December 21, 2023 at
6:03 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Vice Chair Roman.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Commissioner Hernandez
  Commissioner Rodriguez
  Vice Chairmember Roman
  Chairmember Winford
ABSENT
  1 Commissioner Gonzalez

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
This is the time for the Planning Commission to discuss any changes in the order of agenda
items.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to (1) Re­open the public hearing to consider Zoning Ordinance Amendment
  2024­614 and General Plan Amendment 2024­615; (2) Take public comments; (3) Provide
  comments and feedback on the Zone Ordinance Amendment and General Plan Amendment;
  and (4) Adopt Resolution No. 2023­007, recommending that the City Council approve Zoning
  Ordinance Amendment 2024­614; approve General Plan Amendment 2024­615, and adopt the
  finding that CEQA does not apply to these actions.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  John Natalizio,
  PLANNING  AssistantMINUTES
  COMMISSION  City Attorney, provided the staff report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Vice Chairmember Roman, that

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Hernandez, Rodriguez, Roman, Winford
  NOES: 0;

  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

B.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Staff Reports.

C.  ORAL COMMISSIONER REPORT(S)

Vice Chair Roman give a shoutout to Public Works staff for cleaning up graffiti.

Commissioner Rodriguez wished everyone a Merry Christmas

Chair Winford announced that he was pleased with the parade.

D.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:43 PM.
